params.1273: Set fire to a regular log.
params.1274: Get a regular log (you can cut one from a normal tree if you have a hatchet).
params.1275: Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge can give you a hatchet.
params.1276: You will need a tinderbox (you can get one free from a general store).
params.1277: Click on the tinderbox in your inventory and then on your logs to light them.
params.1278: Make sure the ground you're standing on is clear enough to light your logs on.
params.2225: You can use raw food on a fire to cook it and make it edible. You also earn Firemaking experience for lighting logs; higher Firemaking lets you light harder logs.
